cohort: The cohort consisted of 90 pairs of neonates, with cases undergoing therapeutic hypothermia for Neonatal Encephalopathy (NE) and controls being normal neonates, matched for gestational age, birth weight, days of age, and sex.
finding: Neonates with Neonatal Encephalopathy (NE) exhibited impaired right and left ventricular strain mechanics, with lower RV Strain and LV 4Ch strain associated with increased medical support and decreased survival to discharge.
